name: The Falcon Huntress
review:
A huntress and her falcon on the Mongolian steppe, on 9 lines with expanding wins and free spins that can retrigger.

Expanding wins spread winning symbols across the reels, turning a small line hit into something bigger, and retriggers can stretch the hunt out. It's a good-looking game with a simple setup and not much to learn. High volatility, 10,052x cap, 96.1% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
